claims.claim: SymCE supplies 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures each paired with an executable Python verifier.
claims.episode_span: SymCE supplies 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures each paired with an executable Python verifier that also serves as the reward function.
claims.source_title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
claims.supporting_quote: We frame counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against a deterministic per-theorem Python verifier, and release SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures, each paired with executable verifiers.
